localBiteReport: The most recent reports (from the past 1–2 weeks) from Choctawhatchee Bay guides indicate that redfish and speckled trout have been heating up in the bayou and along dock structures, with the fall pattern kicking in as the Destin Fishing Rodeo gets underway this October. Slot-sized redfish are being caught around lighted docks and drop-offs, and trout remain a consistent target; one local Santa Rosa Beach captain noted catching slots around docks and a few trout, with sheepshead expected to improve at bay structures in the coming weeks. Half Hitch's Destin report from late September noted redfish as the dominant bay species, with trout active after dark around dock lights — a pattern that typically carries into mid-October. Water temperature is 82°F. Note: the most detailed Half Hitch bay fishing content available is from their 9-28-26 and 9-7-26 reports (roughly 2 weeks and 5 weeks old, respectively), as the October report had not yet been published at time of check.
